known_facts_book1: Is the egg Alice bought from the Sheep, grown larger and more human until she sees it is Humpty Dumpty himself.
Sits with his legs crossed like a Turk on the top of a very narrow high wall, and finds it provoking to be called an egg.
Says his name means the shape he is, and that Alice's name is stupid enough because it could mean any shape.
Says the King has promised him with his very own mouth to send all his horses and all his men if he ever fell.
Wears a cravat, an un-birthday present from the White King and Queen, which Alice mistakes for a belt.
Works out with Alice that there are three hundred and sixty-four days a year for un-birthday presents.
Says 'When I use a word, it means just what I choose it to mean—neither more nor less', and that the question is which is to be master.
Says he pays words extra when he makes them do a lot of work, and that they come round him of a Saturday night for their wages.
Explains the hard words of 'Jabberwocky': brillig, slithy as a portmanteau, toves, gyre, gimble, wabe, mimsy, borogove, mome raths and outgrabe.
Recites the poem about sending a message to the fish, which breaks off unfinished at the locked door.
Dismisses Alice with 'I shouldn't know you again if we did meet—you're so exactly like other people', and complains her face is the same as everybody's.
Is left sitting on the wall with his eyes shut, and a moment later a heavy crash shakes the forest from end to end.
Is reported by the White Queen to have come to the door with a corkscrew in his hand, looking for a hippopotamus.

known_relations_book1.Alice: Argues with her about names, words and age; never learns to recognise her and says good-bye twice.
known_relations_book1.White King: Promised him all his horses and all his men, and gave him the cravat.
known_relations_book1.White Queen: Gave him the cravat with the King, and later tells the story of his corkscrew visit.
known_relations_book1.Sheep: Sold Alice the egg he grew out of.

not_in_this_book: the King's men put Humpty Dumpty together again
Humpty Dumpty is mended after his fall
Humpty Dumpty rules an egg kingdom
invented_biography: Humpty Dumpty is a wealthy merchant
